QF.id: Retirement Planning Products: National Pension System (NPS)_50

question.text: Under the new tax regime, which NPS-related deduction is available to employees?

answer.text: Section 80CCD(2) for employer contribution up to 14%

explanation.text: The Logic: The first part of NISM Series XVII workbook p. 144 expressly states that, under the new tax regime, employer contribution is allowed as a deduction under Section 80CCD(2) up to 14% of Basic + DA for Central Government employees. Anchored to that statement, option C is the supported answer. The Trap: Option D becomes defensible if a candidate relies on the later sentence on the same page, which says employee deduction and 80CCD(2) deduction have been disallowed under the new regime — an internal contradiction the audit flagged. Options A and B refer to 80CCD(1) and 80CCD(1B), which are tied to the old regime and are not preserved under the new regime. Note: The original stem implicitly asked candidates to choose between contradictory sentences on the same workbook page. The keyed answer (C) is anchored to the first, more specific statement on p. 144 about 80CCD(2) and the 14% cap for Central Government employees. Candidates should verify against the latest Finance Act before applying this in practice.
